fields.description: Stored save-slot checksum: bitwise NOT of (sum of slot bytes with this word zeroed, plus a constant seed). Computed by FUN_080025ac, stored by FUN_08002540, verified on load by FUN_08002460.
fields.evidence: FUN_080025ac zeroes *buffer then sums bytes 0..limit and returns ~sum; FUN_08002540 stores it at buffer+0; FUN_08002460 recomputes and compares. Baseline save offset 0 holds 0xfffff9a7.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: Save-slot magic identifier 0xABCD. Load path FUN_08002460 compares word at buffer+4 against the expected magic and re-initializes defaults via FUN_08002344 on mismatch.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002460 checks *(ushort *)(load_buf+4) == expected magic, else calls FUN_08002344; FUN_08002344 writes (short)_DAT_0800244c at buffer+4. Baseline offsets 4..5 are CD AB (0xABCD).
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Slot status flag, default 1. First config byte of the gameplay struct; set to 1 by the default-init routine.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 executes *(save_struct+6) = 1 (u32-word index 6 = byte 0x18); baseline byte 0x18 is 0x01; mirror byte 0x4E8 (slot B +0x18) is 0x01.
fields.name: slot_active_flag

fields.description: Config triplet group A, entry 0 (default 2). One of two symmetric 3-byte groups flanking the option flags; consistent with per-side (P1/P2 or story/versus) 3-state settings.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x1C = 2 (*(save_struct+7)); baseline bytes 0x1C..0x1E are 02 02 02 with mirror bytes 0x4E4..0x4E6 also 02 02 02.
fields.name: cfg_group_a0

fields.description: Config triplet group A, entry 1 (default 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x1D = 2; baseline byte 0x1D is 0x02; slot-B mirror byte 0x4E5 is 0x02.
fields.name: cfg_group_a1

fields.description: Config triplet group A, entry 2 (default 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x1E = 2; baseline byte 0x1E is 0x02; slot-B mirror byte 0x4E6 is 0x02.
fields.name: cfg_group_a2

fields.description: Option flag B, default 1. Single flag byte between the two config triplets.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x25 = 1; baseline byte 0x25 is 0x01; slot-B mirror byte 0x4ED is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_b

fields.description: Config triplet group B, entry 0 (default 2). Mirrors group A layout.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x28 = 2 (*(save_struct+10)); baseline bytes 0x28..0x2A are 02 02 02 with mirror bytes 0x4F0..0x4F2 also 02 02 02.
fields.name: cfg_group_b0

fields.description: Config triplet group B, entry 1 (default 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x29 = 2; baseline byte 0x29 is 0x02; slot-B mirror byte 0x4F1 is 0x02.
fields.name: cfg_group_b1

fields.description: Config triplet group B, entry 2 (default 2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x2A = 2; baseline byte 0x2A is 0x02; slot-B mirror byte 0x4F2 is 0x02.
fields.name: cfg_group_b2

fields.description: Option flag C, default 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x31 = 1; baseline byte 0x31 is 0x01; slot-B mirror byte 0x4F9 is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_c

fields.description: Option flag D, default 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0x34 = 1 (*(save_struct+0xD)); baseline byte 0x34 is 0x01; slot-B mirror byte 0x4FC is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_d

fields.description: Option flag E, default 1, in the trailing flag pair near the end of the used slot region.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0xE9 = 1 (and word-index 0x3A = byte 0xE8 = 1); baseline bytes 0xE8..0xE9 are 01 01 with mirror bytes 0x5B0..0x5B1 also 01 01.
fields.name: option_flag_e

fields.description: Option flag F, default 1; pairs with option_flag_e.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 writes byte 0xE9 = 1; baseline byte 0xE9 is 0x01; slot-B mirror byte 0x5B1 is 0x01.
fields.name: option_flag_f

fields.description: Stage/select index (default 1): last used byte of the 0x4C8 slot. Consumed as a table index (multiplied by stride 0x144) to load stage parameters.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002344 sets word-index 0x130 = byte 0x4C0 to 1; FUN_0800b550 reads byte (state_base+0x4C0) as index: *(uint)idx * 0x144 + table + 0x10/0x11/0x15/0x16. Baseline 0x4C0 and mirror 0x988 are 0x01.
fields.name: stage_select_index

fields.description: Redundant mirror of save_checksum written by the store path; identical value proves the dual-slot save scheme.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002540 writes the same checksum word to SRAM 0x0E000000 and to the mirror SRAM region; baseline 0x0000..0x0003 and 0x04C8..0x04CB are both A7 F9 FF FF.
fields.name: save_checksum_mirror

fields.description: Redundant mirror of save_magic in slot B.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002540 mirrors the full 0x4C8 slot; baseline 0x04CC..0x04CD are CD AB (0xABCD), matching slot A.
fields.name: save_magic_mirror

fields.description: Redundant mirror of slot_active_flag in slot B (slot B byte 0x18).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002540 mirrors the full 0x4C8 slot; baseline byte 0x4E0 (0x4C8+0x18) is 0x01, matching slot A byte 0x18.
fields.name: slot_active_flag_mirror

fields.description: Redundant mirror of stage_select_index in slot B (slot B byte 0x4C0).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002540 mirrors the full 0x4C8 slot; baseline byte 0x988 (0x4C8+0x4C0) is 0x01, matching slot A byte 0x4C0.
fields.name: stage_select_index_mirror

fields.description: Auxiliary-block checksum word (second save region handled by FUN_080024E8/FUN_08002574/FUN_080025E8). Block payload is all zeros in the baseline so only the checksum word is observable.
fields.evidence: FUN_080025E8 computes ~sum over the aux RAM struct and FUN_08002574 stores it to two SRAM spots; baseline 0x0990..0x0993 and 0x30D8..0x30DB are both B2 D8 FF FF.
fields.name: aux_checksum

fields.description: Redundant mirror of aux_checksum in the second SRAM location.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002574 writes the aux checksum word to two SRAM regions; baseline 0x30D8..0x30DB is B2 D8 FF FF, matching 0x0990..0x0993.
fields.name: aux_checksum_mirror
